review:
A satire on airport queues, with a feature meter above the reels. Each spin can fill it with modifiers: Quarantine removes low symbols, Full Body Scanner upgrades a low symbol, Not My Bag drops three to six matching mystery symbols, and Arm Slides turns every wild into a full reel.

xZone and xSplit add more ways to grow or split the reels. Every spin feels like a little modifier lottery. Extreme volatility, 19,693x max, 96.07% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
